name: trace_recovery_messages
description: Controls verbosity of recovery-related debugging messages; overrides log_min_messages for recovery-specific logs.
symptoms: Inability to troubleshoot Hot Standby lag or errors
Excessive log volume causing disk I/O pressure or log rotation failures
tuning_tips: Set to 'debug1'–'debug5' only during targeted recovery troubleshooting; revert to 'log' or higher in production to avoid log bloat. Requires reload (not restart) to take effect.
